name: Kerjaya Prospek Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团通过子公司Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd.分步收购ES Sunlogy Berhad的股权（先认购9.09%新股，再收购19.18%及额外2.73%股权），并完成对Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd.剩余40%股权的收购，从而全资拥有该公司。同时，集团与Aspen Vision Land Sdn. Bhd.的49%股权投资已完成，Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd.与Railway Assets Corporation的开发协议期限多次延长。建筑业务方面，Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn.
overview_en: In 2026, the Group, through its subsidiary Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd., acquired stakes in ES Sunlogy Berhad in stages (subscribing 9.09% of new shares, then acquiring 19.18% and an additional 2.73%), and completed the acquisition of the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd., making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Meanwhile, the 49% equity investment in Aspen Vision Land Sdn. Bhd. was completed, and the development agreement period between Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 建筑
segments.note: 今年将总值RM25,067,486.00的分包工程授予Savelite Engineering Sdn. Bhd.。
segments.note_en: This year, sub-contract works totaling RM25,067,486.00 were awarded to Savelite Engineering Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd.将两份分包合约授予Savelite Engineering Sdn. Bhd.，合约总额RM25,067,486.00。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Kerjaya Prospek (M) Sdn. Bhd. awarded two sub-contracts to Savelite Engineering Sdn. Bhd. for a total contract sum of RM25,067,486.00.

segments.name: 房地产
segments.note: 今年完成对Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd.剩余40%股权的收购，并推进与Aspen Vision Land Sdn.
segments.note_en: This year, the acquisition of the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd. was completed, and the 49% equity investment in Aspen Vision Land Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd.剩余40%股权及终止合资协议的先决条件达成，收购完成。
actions.text_en: The conditions precedent for the acquisition of the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd. and the termination of the joint venture agreement were fulfilled, and the acquisition was completed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd.与Aspen Vision Tanjung Sdn. Bhd.订立有条件合资协议及认购与股东协议，以收购Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd.剩余40%股权并终止原有合资协议。
actions.text_en: Kerjaya Prospek Ventures Sdn. Bhd. entered into a conditional joint venture agreement and share subscription and shareholders' agreement with Aspen Vision Tanjung Sdn. Bhd. to acquire the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接持股55%的子公司Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd.与Railway Assets Corporation就一幅开发土地的拟议收购及开发订立开发协议。
actions.text_en: Indirect 55%-owned subsidiary Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd. entered into a development agreement with Railway Assets Corporation in relation to the proposed acquisition and development of a development land.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方再将开发协议签署期限延长至2026年6月30日。
actions.text_en: The parties further extended the deadline for executing the definitive agreement to 30 June 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方进一步将开发协议签署期限延长至2026年5月31日。
actions.text_en: The parties further extended the deadline for executing the definitive agreement to 31 May 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd.与Railway Assets Corporation同意将开发协议签署期限延长至2026年4月30日。
actions.text_en: Rivanis Ventures Sdn. Bhd. and Railway Assets Corporation mutually agreed to extend the deadline for executing the definitive agreement to 30 April 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 合资协议及认购与股东协议的所有先决条件于2026年2月27日达成，协议变为无条件。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent of the joint venture agreement and share subscription and shareholders' agreement were fulfilled on 27 February 2026, and the agreements became unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述合资协议及认购与股东协议的先决条件达成期限延长至2026年2月28日，以便办理土地产权登记至特殊目的公司。
actions.text_en: The deadline for fulfilling conditions precedent of the joint venture agreement and share subscription and shareholders' agreement was extended to 28 February 2026 to facilitate registration of land titles to the SPV.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面通过Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd.分步收购ES Sunlogy Berhad股权，并续期 recurrent related party transactions 股东授权。
segments.note_en: At the group level this year, Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd. acquired stakes in ES Sunlogy Berhad in stages, and the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions was renewed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd.通过直接商业交易收购ES Sunlogy Berhad额外2.73%股权。
actions.text_en: Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd. acquired an additional 2.73% equity interest in ES Sunlogy Berhad through direct business transactions.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd.以每股平均RM0.272收购ES Sunlogy Berhad额外147,700,000股普通股，占19.18%股权。
actions.text_en: Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd. acquired an additional 147,700,000 ordinary shares in ES Sunlogy Berhad at an average price of RM0.272 per share, representing a 19.18% equity interest.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 集团通过Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd.收购ES Sunlogy Berhad 19.18%股权，加上此前认购的9.09%新股，集团成为ES Sunlogy Berhad的主要股东之一。
model_changes.text_en: The Group, through Acumen Marketing Sdn. Bhd., acquired a 19.18% equity interest in ES Sunlogy Berhad; together with the earlier subscription of 9.09% new shares, the Group became one of the major shareholders of ES Sunlogy Berhad.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 集团完成收购Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd.剩余40%股权，该公司成为集团全资子公司。
model_changes.text_en: The Group completed the acquisition of the remaining 40% equity interest in Tanjung Bungah Development Sdn. Bhd., which became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Group.
